title: Torch Lake Sandbar
new_html:
A Must-Visit Gem Near Bellaire, MI

More info: torchlake.com
Location: South end of Torch Lake near the Torch River (Rapid City / Alden area); reached by boat from Bellaire via Lake Bellaire, Clam Lake and Torch Lake

Access: Best reached by boat, kayak, or jet ski; rentals available nearby

Torch Lake Sandbar is famous for its stunning, crystal-clear turquoise waters and soft sandy bottom. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and boating, it's a must-visit spot for a relaxing day on the water. Bring your snacks and sunscreen, and enjoy this beautiful natural gem!

FAQs – What Guests Should Know

  • How do I get there?
    You'll need a boat or watercraft—rent from a nearby marina or charter a cruise with a captain for a no-hassle trip.
  • Can we swim at the sandbar?
    Yes! The water is shallow and perfect for swimming and wading.
  • Can we bring drinks and snacks?
    Absolutely! Picnic-friendly—just be respectful and take your trash with you.
  • Is it a party spot or family-friendly?
    It can be both! Weekends (especially the Fourth of July) bring a lively crowd, while weekdays are more relaxed.
  • When's the best time to go?
    Arrive early in the day for calmer waters and easy anchoring—especially on weekends and holidays.

Embark on scenic hikes through diverse landscapes, including hardwood forests, wetlands, and coastal dunes. The sandy beach at Rex Beach invites you to relax, swim, or enjoy a peaceful picnic with breathtaking lake views.

Whether you're seeking a quiet escape or an adventure in nature, Antrim Creek Natural Area & Rex Beach offers a perfect blend of outdoor recreation and natural beauty, just a short drive from Bellaire.

Find out more: Visit Charlevoix – Antrim Creek Nature Area

  • Trails are easy to moderate and suitable for most ages.
  • Picnic areas are available; bring your own blanket or chairs.
  • Swimming is allowed at Rex Beach (no lifeguards on duty).

title: Northaire Resort & Pontoon Rentals (Captained Options Available)
new_html:
Website: https://www.northaireresort.com

Phone: (231) 377-7764

Resort & Clam Lake Dock: 7067 Crystal Springs Rd, Bellaire, MI (south shore of Clam Lake, ~15 minutes' drive from downtown Bellaire)

Other Pick-Up Docks: Northaire also has private docks on Torch Lake and in Bellaire—your dock location is confirmed before your trip

Hours: Boat pick-up from 9 a.m., return by 7 p.m. (early pick-up available for a fee)

Experience northern Michigan's shimmering Chain of Lakes with ease and comfort. Northaire's expansive pontoon fleet features spacious, well-maintained boats. Enjoy Bluetooth stereo, GPS depth finder, ladders, bimini tops, and a tow bar for tubing. Begin your journey on Clam Lake, cruise to the turquoise sandbar on Torch Lake, and explore scenic coves and the Grass River. Ideal for bridal showers, bachelor parties, family escapades, or sunset soirees! Jet skis (Torch Lake location), tubes, lily pads and porta-potties are also available to rent.

FAQs

  • Captain Provided? Their 2-hour sunset cruise includes a licensed captain; ask when booking about captained options.
  • Is alcohol allowed? Yes! BYOB welcome (please enjoy responsibly).
  • Are small parties allowed? Absolutely—great for celebrations and group outings.
  • Where do guests board? At one of Northaire's three private docks (resort, Torch Lake, or Bellaire)—not public boat ramps. Double-check your dock before heading out.
  • Boating license needed? Michigan requires anyone born on or after July 1, 1996 to have a boater safety certificate to operate a motorboat; ask Northaire about requirements when booking.

What important tips?

  • Arrive 15 minutes early for check-in and orientation.
  • Bring sunscreen, snacks, and a favorite playlist.
  • Consider renting an onboard porta-potty for larger groups.
  • Practice no-wake speed in shallow zones like the Grass River.

title: Charters North – Captain Shaun’s Custom Cruises
new_html:

Take your vacation to the next level with fully captained boat adventures by Captain Shaun — a local pro, born and raised on Torch Lake, with 30+ years fishing its waters. From fishing excursions to relaxing sandbar cruises, you're in for a custom-tailored experience that's fun, safe, and unforgettable.

FAQ Highlights:
Captain included | Bring your own snacks & drinks | Custom cruise options | Pickup at Torch Lake docks | No license needed

Trip Options:

  • Salmon & Trout Troll: Cruise deep waters of Torch and Elk Lake for lake trout, Atlantic salmon, steelhead and brown trout.
  • Night Walleye Troll: Experience the lake under the stars while chasing walleye.
  • Smallmouth Bass Casting: Their most active trip—cast (or troll) for smallmouth, pike and musky with expert guidance.
  • Fall Perch Fishing: Offered October–December when jumbo perch school up.
  • Custom Cruises: A day at the sandbar, sunset cruise, nature tour—Captain Shaun creates your perfect day on the water.
  • Fish & Sandbar Package: A full 8-hour day for up to 6 people—fish in the morning, then unwind at Torch Lake's famous sandbar.

More Details:

  • Captain Provided: Yes — all trips are fully captained and guided.
  • Bring Your Own: Snacks and beverages welcome—cooler full of ice and bottled water provided.
  • Groups: Custom Cruises and the Fish & Sandbar package are great for relaxed group trips or sunset gatherings.
  • Boating License: Not required—Captain Shaun handles all operations. Anglers need a Michigan fishing license.
  • What to Bring: Comfortable clothes, rain gear, sun protection, food and drinks. Fish cleaning and packaging are included free on fishing trips.

title: Grass River Natural Area — Kayaking & Nature Escape
new_html:
Website: https://www.grassriver.org/
Phone: (231) 533-8576 (Grass River Center)
Location Guide: 6500 Alden Hwy, Bellaire, MI 49615 - About 10 minutes' drive from downtown Bellaire
Hours: Trails open daily, dawn to dusk; Grass River Center open daily 10 a.m.–4 p.m. May–October (weekends Nov–Apr)

Immerse yourself in nature at Grass River Natural Area, a 1,500-acre preserve perfect for kayaking and wildlife viewing. Paddle the calm Grass River framed by forests and wetlands and spot local wildlife in their natural habitat. Kayak rentals are available seasonally, letting you explore on your own, or join a guided kayak tour to learn about the area's rich ecology.

Guest Tips:

  • Kayak rentals are available June through September and must be reserved in advance by phone.
  • Rentals run during Center hours (10 AM–4 PM) and leave from the Grass River Overlook; kayaks must be back by 4 PM. About $30 for 2–3 hours or $50 for 4–6 hours.
  • Only six single kayaks (no tandems), for adults and teens only.
  • Wear comfortable, water-friendly footwear and bring insect repellent.
  • Don't miss the boardwalk trails—dogs are allowed on-leash only on the Rail and Algonquin trails, not the boardwalks.

With well-maintained boats, slips, a ship's store and full marina services, they cater to both casual cruisers and watersports fans. Launch your adventure right to the iconic turquoise waters and sandbar—the perfect backdrop for a memorable lake day!

FAQs:

  • Do boats come with a captain?
    Rentals are self-drive; staff provide an orientation before launch.
  • Do I need a boating license?
    Michigan requires a boater safety certificate for anyone born on or after July 1, 1996 to operate a motorboat.
  • Is a reservation recommended?
    Absolutely—especially during the summer, when popular boats book quickly.
  • Where do I return the boat?
    Back to the marina's docks, where staff can help with docking.

Set sail from a classic Up North destination with the largest fleet of pontoons on Torch Lake, Clam Lake and Lake Bellaire! Northaire Resort has been making lake dreams come true since 1948. With private docks at the resort on Clam Lake, on Torch Lake, and in Bellaire, it's the ideal launch point for everything from tranquil morning cruises to tubing afternoons and golden-hour sunset rides.

Their boats come with Bluetooth stereo, GPS depth finder, bimini top, ladder, changing room and a tow bar for tubing. Tubes, lily pads and porta-potties are available to add on, and jet skis rent from the Torch Lake location. Whether you're celebrating something big or just living your best lake life, Northaire makes it seamless and stress-free.

FAQs

  • Are captains available?
    Yes, on the captained 2-hour Torch Lake sunset cruise; ask about other options when booking.
  • Where do we pick up the boat?
    At one of Northaire's three private docks (resort, Torch Lake, or Bellaire)—not public ramps. Confirm your dock before heading out.
  • Can we bring our own food and drinks?
    Absolutely—coolers, snacks, and beverages are welcome on board.
  • What are the rental hours?
    Pick-up begins at 9 AM and boats are due back by 7 PM; early pick-up is available for an hourly fee.
  • How far is it to the Torch Lake Sandbar?
    The sandbar is at the south end of Torch Lake; from Clam Lake you'll head out the Clam River into Torch Lake and cruise south.

Experience lake freedom with Vacation Water Sports—a rental outfitter that delivers jet skis and pontoons to drop-off locations around the Chain of Lakes, so you can start your adventure without towing a thing. Whether you're chasing thrills on a jet ski or cruising Lake Bellaire and Torch Lake in comfort, their daily and multi-day rentals make boat days effortless and fun.

FAQs

  • Will they deliver near our rental?
    They deliver to set drop-off locations on the lakes they serve; other locations may be available on request (extra charge may apply)—call to arrange.
  • Can we rent for multiple days?
    Yes—1 to 10 day rentals; a 3-day minimum applies July 3–Aug 16 (holiday rates; no refunds for 4th of July week).
  • What lakes do they service?
    Torch Lake, Clam Lake, Lake Bellaire, Intermediate Lake & Elk Lake.
  • How long is a one-day rental?
    8 hours. Tubes for pontoons are free; fuel is charged at marina rates.
  • Any rules to know?
    No pets, and boat capacity limits are strictly enforced. Waivers are completed online for each driver/rider.
